title: Diwali Celebration at JJ. Shramshala
summary: What an incredible experience at JJ Dharamshala! ❤️ ON 23rd October , we celebrated Diwali in its true spirit—spreading love, joy, and happiness among the elderly residents.
description:
What an incredible experience at JJ Dharamshala! ❤️

ON 23rd October , we celebrated Diwali in its true spirit—spreading love, joy, and happiness among the elderly residents. It was truly heart-warming to see their smiles and share these precious moments with them. ✨

A heartfelt thank you to Anushree, Swati, Sadhana, Pankaj, Rajkumar, Roshnee, Mukesh, Sunita, Shilpa, and Sanjeev for your melodious singing and wonderful contributions.
A big thank you to Rupal, Suman, Arun, Shilpa Mehta, Haresh, Chetna and Jayshreefor your valuable presence, support, and kindness. Your contribution made this celebration even more special. 🙏❤️

A special thank you to Rtn. Kalpana Jain for sponsoring the groceries, and heartfelt gratitude to all our generous donors for supporting this meaningful initiative. Your generosity helped make this celebration possible. 🌸🙏

Celebrating Diwali in the true spirit of giving, sharing, and caring! ❤️🌟
location: Sir JJ Dharamshala Jehangir Boman Behram Road, near Sagar Hotel, Nagpada, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400008.
